txf.notice.unshimmed.en:
{0} is using the mount {1} and can open a file inside a transaction.

This volume cannot accept a transactional open, so saving through it fails with error 6832 (the image {2}). Start it through the compatibility layer?

A program that is already running keeps the behaviour it started with until it is restarted.
txf.notice.unshimmed.zh-CN:
{0} 正在使用挂载 {1}，并且能够在事务中打开文件。

这个卷无法接受事务性打开，经由它的保存会失败（错误 6832，依据：{2}）。要让它经由兼容层启动吗？

已经在运行的程序要保持到重启后才生效。

txf.notice.restart.en:
{0} was started before the compatibility layer was enabled, so it is still running without it.

Restart it for the change to take effect.
txf.notice.restart.zh-CN:
{0} 在启用兼容层之前就已经启动，因此现在仍在没有兼容层的情况下运行。

请重启它，改动才会生效。

txf.panel.summary.one.en: 1 program starts through the compatibility layer
txf.panel.summary.one.zh-CN: {0} 个程序经由兼容层启动

txf.panel.summary.many.en: {0} programs start through the compatibility layer
txf.panel.summary.many.zh-CN: {0} 个程序经由兼容层启动

txf.panel.empty.en: No program is started through the shim yet. Add the folder the program's executables are in.
txf.panel.empty.zh-CN: 还没有程序经由兼容层启动。把那个程序的可执行文件所在目录加进来。

txf.drift.missing.en: the record says this image is instrumented, but its Debugger value is gone
txf.drift.missing.zh-CN: 记录说这个程序已经插桩，但它的 Debugger 值已经不在了

txf.drift.changed.en: the Debugger value points at '{0}', not at '{1}'

txf.drift.unrecorded.en: a Debugger value points at this plugin's launcher, but the record has no entry for it
txf.drift.unrecorded.zh-CN: 有个 Debugger 值指向本插件的启动器，但记录里没有对应的条目

txf.panel.remove.confirm.en: {0} will start as it did before the shim was installed. A program that is running now keeps the shim until it is restarted.
txf.panel.remove.confirm.zh-CN: {0} 会恢复成安装兼容层之前的样子启动。正在运行的程序要保持到重启后才生效。
